text: Good morning everyone. Welcome, let's get started.
So, I run a community called OpenSverige.

slide.headline: OpenSverige
slide.metaphor: A Swedish flag represents the community's identity and pride.

text: It's Sweden's open community for AI agents and vibe coding.
And it all started in a Discord server. Nothing fancy.

text: Just a bunch of people who wanted to build things instead of talking about building things.

text: Today I want to tell you three things.
One, we ship. Two, we share. Three, we never wait for permission.

text: Here's the funny part. Half of our channels are in Swedish.
